note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.baseline_tension: The net-negative lean cuts against a strong call skew (-12.88) but agrees with the reaction history (5 of 7 down). Most of what I found is already in a price that rallied about 50% through it, so the sum is small and the emitted move smaller still.

findings.finding: The Q4 guide was set on 2026-06-18, one day after the US-Iran Islamabad Memorandum (2026-06-17). The ceasefire then collapsed on 2026-07-08, mid-quarter, and hostilities were renewed in September (the Bab al-Mandab crisis). That leaves Accenture's Middle East consulting (Q3: about $100m revenue and about $400m of sales hit) facing a worse backdrop for the FY27 guide than the one management guided against. Consensus Q4 revenue of $18.04bn sits within 0.2% of the $18.075bn midpoint even though management said 'more of the range in play'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-06-18 a guide shortfall of $18.075bn midpoint against $18.47bn expected, with the Middle East named, went with -17.97%, the largest move in the baseline. Five of the seven prints in the baseline were down.

findings.finding: Accenture Federal Services won the $821m War Data Platform integration task order on 2026-07-09, and Accenture signed a roughly EUR200m seven-year NATO NCIA contract on 2026-07-07. Both fall inside fiscal Q4 (June-August). The one-source Q4 bookings bar of $19.9bn is 6.6% below Q4 FY25's $21.3bn, and management had said federal headwinds were sunsetting and consulting bookings had grown four quarters running.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bookings is the line this stock trades on. The Q3 bookings of $19.3bn (-2% y/y, -13% q/q) came with an EPS beat and still went with -17.97% on 2026-06-18. A bookings upside surprise has no clean instance in the baseline.

outside_window.finding: The Accenture Investor Day on 2026-10-14 ('AI: A declaration of autonomy') is where the AI pipeline and FY27 organic story will be laid out. Wells Fargo said neither it nor the print is likely to be a positive catalyst.
The $480m Army JETMS award (2026-09-10) falls in fiscal Q1 FY27, not Q4 bookings, so it shows up in Q1 FY27 bookings reported in December.

lessons_applied: Rule 5 (macro-to-company is a hypothesis) and rule 6 (inside the guide is expected): the Middle East finding went from -1.5 to -0.7. The Q4 guide already assumed disruption through the quarter, and the FY27 transmission is not stated by the company
Rule 7 (a sign against strong skew needs a reason or a smaller size): I gave no stronger reason why a -12.9 call skew is wrong, so the size is shrunk and the emitted move is pulled toward zero
Rule 6 (bar with one source is capped): the bookings finding went from +0.8 to +0.4, because the $19.9bn bookings bar has a single aggregator source
Rule 3 (the caveat has to reach the number): the emitted move is -0.2 against a finding sum of -0.3, and the pre-lessons move of -0.5 is revised to -0.2
Rule 1: print_vs_bar stays near zero (-0.2) and the reaction number is kept separate; the Q3 EPS beat was sold, so EPS/buyback items were kept out of findings
